description: Browse indexed organizations (sites) and what each offers to agents. Use to explore by popularity or to list every site that offers an API, MCP server or agent.

has.description: Only organizations that offer this kind of thing: api, mcp or agent.

offset.description: Number of organizations to skip, for paging (default 0).

q.description: Optional filter on organization name or domain, e.g. "stripe". Leave empty to list everything.

sort.description: Sort order: popular (default, by popularity), capabilities (most operations/tools first) or name (A to Z).

tag.description: Only organizations tagged with this category slug, e.g. payments or maps-location. Get the list from list_tags.

name: browse_organizations
